title: MC: Trailer Edition
description: This is the best modpack to make Minecraft look like the trailers!
body:
![Minecraft Trailer Edition](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa988ffb719b6e1c3aa2d6f50a1dcf5aa9336b69_0.webp)





Have you ever wanted to experience Minecraft like in the trailers? Now you can! This modpack offers a gameplay experience that closely resembles the trailers, featuring Fresh Animations, FA Player Animations, Bare Bones, and much more. It also supports the latest version of the game and allows you to play on servers!!

Shoutout to BlueVis10n for helping create the screenshots!
